description: This Java class, EntityTagMatchersValueValidator, validates that a CharSequence contains a comma-separated list of entity tag matchers, each of which is validated individually. It throws an exception if validation fails.

classes.name: EntityTagMatchersValueValidator
classes.description: A final immutable class that validates comma-separated EntityTagMatcher strings using a provided validator.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of EntityTagMatchersValueValidator, ensuring the provided validator is not null.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Splits the input CharSequence into individual entity tag matchers and validates each using the provided validator.
